rationale: M60 XML deep review, finding D3. The pre-fix analyzer had no branch at all for `GEDecl`, `PEDecl` or `NotationDecl`, so a DTD's entity and notation declarations produced nothing: measured over the lane's 7,975-file corpus, 590 general entities (16 published), 92 parameter entities (1), 5 notations (0), and 10 parameter entities carrying an external ID — a real import of another file — that produced no edge. `GEDecl`'s `NDATA` and a `NOTATION (a|b)` attribute type name a NOTATION, and `<!ELEMENT catalog (entry+)>` names `entry` in its content model; all three are declarations in the tree and all three were dropped, and each of them is a `contains` edge whose target must resolve to a symbol. Line discipline: the external-ID edge's target is the PATH, so the edge carries the line the path is written on and never the line of the `SYSTEM` keyword (M59.A7 / #825) — `shared.dtd` is on 3, `logo.png` on 4, `image/png` on 6, and `catalog.dtd` on 2. Lines are read off the file.

expectRelationships.note: NDATA names the notation an unparsed entity points at

X14: two RULES produce this one edge — `<!ELEMENT catalog (entry+)>` is a content-model reading (usage_contextual) and `<catalog><entry/></catalog>` is a nesting reading (structural) — and they are the same `contains catalog -> entry` pair. `evidenceClass` can only carry the primary role's tier, so the secondary role rode on `alsoRoles` with its tier UNRECORDED, which made the field present but not queryable. `alsoRoleTiers` pairs each role with its tier, as an ordered array so its order cannot disagree with `alsoRoles`.
a NOTATION attribute type declares a dependency on those notations
the second notation of `NOTATION (png|jpg)` is a declaration too

a NOTATION attribute type: the same shape — the document stating an allowed value, not a containment.
a DTD containing a declaration it makes is structural: the containment is read straight off the tree.

forbidRelationships.note: `<!ENTITY plain "replacement">` has an EntityValue, not an ExternalID; there is no file to import
a NOTATION reference is structural containment, not a file import
the external ID is on the ENTITY (line 3), so the edge is shared -> shared.dtd; an implementation that stamps the whole doctypedecl's line fails here

the pre-fix line: `PUBLIC` is written on 2, the PATH the edge names is on 3. M59.A7/#825 — an edge points at the line its TARGET NAME is written on, and the target here is the path, not the keyword. This forbid is what makes the line mutant non-vacuous: with a single-line DOCTYPE the two lines coincide and any line rule passes.
the use site, not the declaration site: one edge for two writings of the name, and the line is the EARLIEST (9)
